text:
maya: Quick sync — want to schedule a design review for the new streaming API + SDK ergonomics + Console UX (partial-response streaming feature). Goal: sign off on API shape, SDK surface, and Console pre-read/visuals. Pre-read: <https://redwood.company/rfcs/streaming-partial|RFC: streaming partial responses> and a short demo GIF.

oliver: SG. Who do we need in the room for API surface review? cc @jess for console UX.

jess: please add a Console section in the pre-read with two mockups (compact list + expanded inspector). I can draft tonight. Also: can we include a short acceptance checklist?

maya: reviewers: oliver (backend), jess (frontend/ux), liam (platform), + one ML infra reviewer (TBD). Proposed times: Fri 11am PT or Mon 9am PT. Which works?

liam: Fri 11am PT works for me. Prefer shorter meeting (45m) and a hard pre-read cutoff 24h before.

oliver: I can do Fri 11am PT. 45m ok. Will ping ML infra for reviewer.

jess: Fri 11am PT ok. I'll upload mockups by EOD tonight and put a short checklist in the pre-read.

maya: great — checklist draft (put this in pre-read):
```
- Read RFC: streaming partial responses (5–10 min)
- API: review new endpoints and error modes
- SDK: confirm method signatures and streaming iterator semantics
- Console: mockups + edge cases (pause/resume, partial tokens)
- Acceptance: perf SLOs + fallback behavior verified
```

jess: added Console mockups and a short video — link in RFC. also noted accessibility concerns for live partial updates.

deploy-bot: RFC updated: streaming-partial-responses.md (v3) — diff: +api.md +console-mocks.gif

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Design Review — Streaming API/SDK/Console — Fri 2024-06-14 11:00 PT (45m) — Zoom link added. Invite: maya, oliver, jess, liam, ml-infra-rotating.

maya: awesome. Action items before EOD tomorrow: oliver — add brief example payloads in RFC; jess — finalize mockups; liam — confirm perf targets; ml-infra — volunteer to review. If you can't make Fri, drop availability here and we'll move to Mon 9am PT. :thumbsup:

oliver: will add payload examples today.

jess: mockups done, uploaded. noted edge-case flows in comments.

liam: perf targets posted in RFC comments.

maya: thanks all — closing thread. We'll use the first 15m for API/SDK, next 25m for Console UX + Q/A, last 5m for rollout plan and owners. Please mark pre-read done in the doc before the meeting.
